name: gpu-monitor
description: Live NVIDIA GPU panel: utilization, VRAM, temperature and power from nvidia-smi, with a one-minute history

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often nvidia-smi is read while the panel is open or a watched tool runs

autoOpen.title: Open during watched tools
autoOpen.description: Open the GPU panel when a tool whose name matches 'Watched tools' starts

watchTools.title: Watched tools
watchTools.description: Case-insensitive text matched against tool names (e.g. comfy matches the comfy-mcp tools); empty watches nothing
